biggest_catch: Requires closing neither the account nor meeting terms within 60 days, but if the account is closed within 6 months of opening, an early termination fee may apply AND the $400 bonus is clawed back — keep it open at least 6 months.
catches: Must complete requirements within the first 60 days of account opening: EITHER receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $1,500+ OR complete 20+ debit card purchases of $20+ each that post to the account.
Qualifying direct deposits = recurring electronic deposits of payroll, Social Security, pension, government benefits, or other eligible regular monthly income.
New checking customers only: must not have closed a Penn Community Bank checking account within the preceding 12 months or received a prior new-checking incentive.

Limit one bonus offer per household; a promotional code must be presented at account opening (400Bonus as reported by aggregators — the official page requires a code but does not print it, so confirm the current code with the bank before applying).
If account is closed within 6 months of opening, early termination fee may apply and the bonus is debited from the final balance.
Bonus is subject to IRS 1099 tax reporting.
Offer expires December 5, 2026 — account must be opened by that date (about 10 weeks from verification; not within 14 days).

Penn Community Bank is a southeastern-PA community bank; aggregator sources report this offer is available only at branches in Lehigh Valley or Montgomery County, PA — confirm availability at a branch before applying.
